# Independent audit of the three-quarter midpoint source inequality

Audited `candidate 6b83c9ea944bc6c0` in full and
ran `supporting computation verify_fixed_mass_midpoint_three_quarter.py`, which passes.

The mathematical theorem passes. The exact two-band feasible domain
and its attainment apply unchanged to the objective s+r. The Fenchel
parameters produce U+Q-hE with h=4k/3-1, and the dimensional inequality
(8) has the correct coefficients after multiplication by d+1.

For d>=20, monotonicity of x log(1+1/x), k>=53/20, h>=38/15, and the
two rational exponential bounds give precisely the claimed positive
gap 1/120+14/(120d). For d=1,...,19, the denominator-cleared expression
(11) is exactly the stated rational gap; its integer certificates and
all separate constants pass the verifier. The midpoint application
counts only one eta copy in the actual cap budget and retains oblique
halfspaces through the exact midpoint indicator implication.

One non-substantive comparison error was found and reported: the two
bounds in equation (2) meet at alpha=1, not alpha=1/2. Their difference
is (1-alpha)/4 after removing gamma_d|B|. Thus the new bound dominates
the old on the entire interval [0,1], with equality at its upper
endpoint. This correction does not change any proof or theorem constant.
